title: Shot Notes Schema
description: User notes for one shot, stored next to its shot log as /h/<6-digit id>.json and exchanged via req:history:notes:get/save. Numeric fields are strings because they hold the raw form input.

id.description: Shot id without zero padding (e.g. "31"); the firmware locates the file by the request id, so this field is informational

beanType.description: Type or origin of coffee beans

doseIn.description: Dose in grams; written automatically at the end of a shot from the profile's dose when empty

doseOut.description: Yield in grams; when set, overrides the recorded volume in the shot index

ratio.description: doseOut / doseIn with two decimals, computed by the web UI
